description: SUPERADMIN ONLY. Save a feed `spec` (the object edge_feed_draft returned, edited or not) as a Lab feed overlay through the same create path as POST /api/admin/edge/feeds: parsed with unknown keys refused, validated (url policy, allowed headers, secret host locks, map fields per type, budgets), then written with the caller as its author and audit-logged. It is saved DISABLED unless `enable: true` — only then does the scheduler fetch it on its ttl while the edge_feeds lane is on. An id that already has an overlay answers overlay_exists (PATCH /api/admin/edge/feeds/<id> edits it). Returns {ok, id, enabled, warnings}. Requires Authorization: Bearer <JWT> of a superadmin.

enable.description: true = enabled on save. Default false.

spec.description: The feed spec: id, title, type, url|fanout|internal, map, source_label, ttl_secs, daily_budget, … (the admin view shape).

name: edge_feed_save
title: Lab — save a feed spec
